sentences.en: I had been inculcated with all kinds of wrong ideas.
sentences.zh: 我被灌输了各种错误的想法。

sentences.en: The teacher inculcates the importance of honesty to her students.
sentences.zh: 老师反复灌输诚实的重要性给她的学生。

sentences.en: Years of training have inculcated discipline into the soldiers.
sentences.zh: 多年的训练已经让纪律深深扎根于士兵们心中。

senses.zh: 极力主张, 反复灌输
